p.espaces.cu_i1: EXW: Buyer handles everything at seller's factory.
p.espaces.cu_i2: FCA: The seller delivers the export-cleared goods to the buyer's carrier.
p.espaces.cu_i3: FOB: The seller loads the cargo on the ship, after which the risk and cost are the buyer's.
p.espaces.cu_i4: CIF: The seller pays the freight and insurance to the port of destination.
p.espaces.cu_i5: DAP: The seller ships to the destination and the buyer pays import duties.
p.espaces.cu_i6: DDP: The seller pays all costs, including import duties.
